scope: Native Fountain browser editor in the actual GitLab application; partial toolbar/providers, not full product acceptance
checks: Normal web sign-in and authenticated API version match the image/source pin
Real private project, PNG upload and issue created through authenticated GitLab HTTP APIs
Real browser clipboard Markdown renders through the actual GitLab service, inserts with reference/marks, and supports one-step undo/redo
Actual HTML omits the unused footnote definition; native paste refuses that incomplete projection, retains exact source and recovers through a supported paste

Actual GitLab controls stay grouped without horizontal overflow at 1440/1100/390px; media actions have distinct rows and separated deletion; keyboard properties, mobile dialog cancellation and toolbar/popup accessibility pass without changing content
Trusted cell-range copy includes its owned note; rich paste grows the real GitLab table, preserves cell roles/marks and note ownership, and one Undo/Redo restores both graphs
A body-row-only table slice refuses standalone GitLab Markdown insertion without changing cell roles, source content or owned notes; editing stays available
secrets: Credential stays in protected task-container configuration and process memory; no credential values, traces or browser storage-state files are recorded

footnoteServerOverlay.scope: Read-only task server overlay; repeat-reference and generated-backlink repair, not an unmodified GitLab baseline

nativeRuntime.scope: Native Fountain/GitLab integration runtime; not a deployed or complete GitLab replacement
